definitions.explanation: So bright that it's difficult to look at directly.
Figuratively describes someone or something that shines impressively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まぶしい。
まぶしくて⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦いられない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It's so bright I can't keep my eyes open.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まぶしくて、⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めた→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: The morning light was so bright that I closed the curtains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まぶしい⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まぶしい。
examples.english: The young people's achievements are brilliant.

examples.japanese: ⟦ステージ→ステージ：11047_suteeji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}っている→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まぶしかった。
examples.english: His figure singing on stage was radiant.

notes:
Can also be written as {眩|まぶ}しい (with kanji).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- まぶしくて〜⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (so bright that one can't ~)
- まぶしい⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧ (so radiant that, dazzlingly)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まぶしい (my eyes are dazzled)

USAGE:
Often used to describe someone who appears brilliant, impressive, or youthful - someone whose brilliance is almost intimidating to look at directly.

- まぶしく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not dazzling)
- まぶしかった (was dazzling)
- まぶしくて (dazzling, and...)
